requirements.quote: `forgedock gc --apply` (owned scope only) should run on an optional systemd user timer or cron entry, installed by `forgedock init` or `doctor --fix` and controlled by a `hygiene.schedule` config key, for example `6h`.
`nearCeiling` should also consider free space on the filesystem that holds the worktree root and `~/.forge`, with a configurable threshold such as `hygiene.min_free_gb`.
A lane admission should run gc and refuse to start a heavy step, such as an image build, when free space is below that threshold.
Write the `.forge-run-owner` marker into every scratch dir ForgeDock creates under `~/.forge/tmp`.
Label compose projects and volumes that lanes start with `forgedock.owner=1` and the lane id, through a compose override or `--label`.
Recognise the legacy `.forge/worktrees/*` layout, reporting only, never reclaiming, unless the dir is clean and its HEAD is on a remote.
The Resource hygiene check (Check 13) should warn when free disk is below the threshold and show the owned bytes it could reclaim.
With `hygiene.auto_gc: true` and a schedule set, owned stale worktrees, volumes and tmp are reclaimed with no batch running.
Unit tests should cover the scheduler entry and the disk-pressure path through the injected host probe.
Dirs with unpushed or uncommitted work, live lanes and unlabelled foreign volumes are still only reported, never reclaimed.

deliverables.change: HYGIENE_DEFAULTS/readHygiene: add schedule (duration or off) and min_free_gb; scan legacy <repo>/.forge/worktrees/* (report-only; reclaim only clean + HEAD on remote + no live proc); own volumes/containers whose compose project label matches forgedock-lane-<n>; hygieneCheck takes free-disk info and warns below threshold, showing owned reclaimable bytes
nearCeiling (and a new diskLow helper) consider free GB of the worktree root and ~/.forge via host.freeMb vs min_free_gb; heavy-step refusal predicate
host probe exposes hygiene paths (worktree root, ~/.forge); makeHeavyIo wiring refuses heavy step when diskLow; run-tmp markers for any other scratch dir created under ~/.forge/tmp
beforeAdmit passes hygiene.min_free_gb, runs gc on disk pressure; pass the refusal to admission/heavy
new: render and install/remove a systemd user timer+service (cron fallback) running `forgedock gc --apply` at hygiene.schedule; injectable exec/fs; no-op when schedule unset
doctor --fix and initFlow install the schedule; Check 13 passes free-disk probe
lane env sets COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME=forgedock-lane-<issue> so compose volumes are owned by name
Docker prompt line: compose override labels forgedock.owner=1 and lane id
record new ownership rules and triggers
tests: legacy worktrees, compose-name volumes, foreign volume untouched, unpushed dir untouched, readHygiene keys, hygieneCheck disk warning
tests: nearCeiling/diskLow via injected host probe, heavy refusal
new: timer/cron entry rendering and install with injected exec

preserve.what: gc dry-run default and ownership rules in bin/gc.mjs planGc: unlabelled containers/volumes, uncommitted/unpushed worktrees, live processes always report-only
checkAdmission behaviour and ADMISSION_DEFAULTS semantics in bin/lean/admission.mjs when min_free_gb is unset
makeRunTmp prune/remove marker rule in bin/lean/effects.mjs (only dirs with .forge-run-owner removed)
existing orchestrate GC flow and reclaimed report line in bin/engine-cli.mjs (auto_gc:false disables it)

decisions.choice: Marker-less ~/.forge/tmp entries (wt-*, stg*, text-*, zero-*, tmp.*) stay report-only; only scratch ForgeDock code creates gets the marker
decisions.justification: devdocs/decisions/4180-gc-reaper.md: unrecognised tmp entries are never touched; no creator found in bin/ or scripts/

decisions.choice: Compose volumes owned by project name forgedock-lane-<n> (COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME) rather than a generated override file
decisions.justification: Lane naming is already an ownership rule (4180 ADR); compose sets com.docker.compose.project on volumes

decisions.choice: Systemd user timer generated at install time, following scripts/systemd/forgedock-bot-token-refresh.timer shape, cron fallback
